items: The facilities manager is responsible ____ coordinating the office relocation scheduled for next month.
All contractors must comply ____ the site's updated safety requirements before beginning work.
Only authorized staff members have access ____ the confidential payroll records.
The fixed expression is 'have access to'.
Employees who complete one year of service become eligible ____ the company's tuition assistance program.
Several clients are interested ____ attending the product demonstration next Thursday.
Please make sure all supervisors are aware ____ the revised overtime approval procedure.
The new technician is already familiar ____ the diagnostic software used in our service centers.
The adjective 'familiar' normally takes 'with' for knowledge of something.
This printer is capable ____ producing more than fifty color pages per minute.
The final delivery date will depend ____ how quickly the supplier can obtain the replacement parts.
Candidates should apply ____ the position through the company's online recruitment portal.
The verb 'apply' takes 'for' when referring to a job or position.
More than eighty employees agreed to participate ____ the annual workplace safety survey.
The consulting firm specializes ____ helping small manufacturers reduce energy costs.
For details about reimbursement limits, please refer ____ the travel policy on the company intranet.
The verb 'refer' takes the preposition 'to' in this meaning.
The training program consists ____ three online modules and a final in-person workshop.
Improved inventory tracking should contribute ____ fewer shipping errors during the holiday season.
Customer-service agents are expected to respond ____ all written complaints within two business days.
The board did not approve ____ the proposal to close the regional warehouse.
The verb 'approve' takes 'of' when it means to regard something favorably.
Several tenants objected ____ the proposed increase in parking fees.
Tomorrow's meeting will focus ____ strategies for improving customer retention.
New employees can benefit ____ the mentoring program during their first six months.
The sales team succeeded ____ securing a three-year contract with the hospital network.
The verb 'succeed' takes the preposition 'in' before a gerund.
The maintenance costs associated ____ older equipment have increased significantly this year.
The updated accounting software is fully compatible ____ the company's existing database system.
The revised budget was based ____ the latest sales forecast and supplier quotations.
All reservations are subject ____ availability at the time the booking is confirmed.
